text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly, a voice showered down from 
above.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous to everyone today too☆ 
Treat and Treat★!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! S-Something is falling from the 
sky...ugh?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Analysis complete. 
Target objects: "Individually packaged 
confectionery items." 
Identified contents: "Marshmallows" and 
"cotton candy."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Awesome~! Look at all the different 
colors! 
I'm gonna grab a pink one♪

text_block_list.name: Happy Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
"That was so fun! How many did you catch?" 
"Five! I'm gonna bring some to my senpai 
later♪"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...When she blurted out, 'Even if it's not 
Halloween☆ 
it's a Marvelous Halloween★,' 
I wondered what crazy thing she was up to 
again...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But everyone looks pretty thrilled 
regardless. 
Guess your 'Marvelous' power really is the 
real deal.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wishes she could bring happiness to 
everyone... 
just like Marvelous-san...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Rice-chan! 
Let's give it a shot, with a big *kaboom*!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You think so...? A-All right!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The mission will commence shortly. 
Let us proceed, Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! 
Rice will make it go *kaboom* too... 
and deliver it to everyone...!
choice_data_list: (Are they planning to put on a show next?)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, full of happiness, 
Rice and the team's exciting stage... 
will now begin...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We've got surprising tricks in store, so 
everyone, look forw—

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meooww, nya, nya♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
M-Mr. Cat...?! No, don't bite the string 
of the pinata! 
Waaiiit~~~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is it my turn already? 
Wait... Waaaah, Rice-chan?!
(*CRASH AND CLATTER!!*)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... Everything is ruined... 
—Huh? R-Rain... Why all of a sudden...?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh no...! 
Is everyone okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice just wanted to make everyone happy... 
I'm so sorry...
choice_data_list: (I-Is she going to be all right...?)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even after Urara-chan and Bourbon-san 
helped out so much... 
Maybe Rice just isn't cut out for this...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my. 
Whatever is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, please don't cry so hard. 
Here, use this to wipe your tears, dear.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for the handkerchief. 
And for listening to my story...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
I understand your plight... 
Yet, there is no need to despair.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
A heart of compassion is the very root of 
virtue. 
...Your actions were truly noble.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No... Rice was just... 
trying to do what she felt like doing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
...Even with the finest intentions, 
not everyone has the courage to act upon 
them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
To empathize with others and care so 
deeply for them 
is your greatest virtue, Rice-san...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-chan is as bright as the sun, 
that's for sure, 
always lifting everyone's spirits. 
But you've got your own special qualities, 
Rice-chan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Chitose O-san and I know it, 
...and I'm sure all the other girls do 
too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Different souls have different aspirations 
and paths to reach them. 
Walking the path that best suits your 
nature is paramount...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice's... own path...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to rush... 
If you take time to quietly look into your 
own heart, 
the way forward will naturally present 
itself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
She's right, dear. 
You're a kind and plucky girl, 
so everything will surely work out. You 
can do it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! 
Rice will do her best...!

Rice Shower had seemed quite downcast 
after 
the trouble the other day, but—
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you're looking well today.

I'm glad you seem back to your usual self 
today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... 
Rice realized that she should just find 
what she can do in her own way...
choice_data_list: Is that so? I'm rooting for you!
I hope I get to see it someday.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... With so many people cheering for 
me, 
Rice is... really lucky.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even if it takes time... I'll see it 
through. 
Because everyone gave me the push I 
needed...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-Really? That makes me so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure... to show you, 
Trainer-san, 
and everyone else too... 
It's a promise...!
